title: Sales & Marketing Executives
description:

SALES & MARKETING EXECUTIVES Islandwide Opportunities | Manufacturing & Distribution A growing manufacturing and distribution company based in St. Ann is expanding its sales team and seeking ambitious, results-driven Sales & Marketing Executives to drive revenue growth, acquire new customers and increase market share across Jamaica. Regional assignments available islandwide. Successful candidates will be responsible for developing business within their assigned territories, growing customer portfolios and achieving established sales and volume targets. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Drive revenue growth through proactive selling, customer acquisition and business development. Identify and secure new business opportunities while expanding existing customer accounts. Develop and maintain strong relationships with distributors, retailers, wholesalers and other key customers. Achieve assigned sales, revenue and product volume targets. Conduct regular field visits and actively develop business within assigned territories. Identify market opportunities, monitor competitor activities and provide relevant market intelligence. Execute promotional initiatives and sales strategies to strengthen product visibility and market penetration. Prepare sales forecasts, pipeline updates and performance reports. WHAT YOU BRING Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Sales or a related discipline. Minimum 3–5 years' experience in sales, marketing or business development, preferably within FMCG, manufacturing or distribution. A proven track record of meeting sales targets, acquiring customers and growing revenue. Strong negotiation, communication and relationship management skills. Commercial awareness, initiative and a results-oriented mindset. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and sales reporting tools. A valid driver's licence and the ability and willingness to travel extensively are essential. Ability to work independently and manage an assigned sales territory. WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU? We offer a competitive employment package designed to support performance and professional success, including: Sales commissions and performance-based incentives. Fuel assistance to support field operations. Communication and technology support, including a company laptop and CUG mobile access. Group health insurance coverage. Opportunities to grow with an expanding manufacturing and distribution business. READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT? Great! We want to hear from you. Submit your résumé and demonstrate your ability to turn opportunities into measurable business growth.
